note: Clinch County GA parcels are published only through the Schneider qPublic/Beacon web viewer (no public REST endpoint; the viewer returns a Cloudflare challenge to automated access). Regrid nationwide tile MapServer layer is not publicly queryable (404 on query endpoint).
